svg.title: Payments Gateway Hub: payment flow
svg.desc: Three flows: A) synchronous charge creation through the orchestrator to Asaas or AbacatePay; B) inbound provider webhooks verified, normalized, deduplicated and applied with retry; C) outbound signed notifications delivered from SQS to the project webhook URL with DLQ on failure.
svg.text: How a payment moves through the hub: charge creation, provider webhooks, and signed notifications back to your app.
hub saves externalId · status · paymentUrl + history, then responds 201 {transaction}
already PAID? enqueue a notification (flow C)
Gateway error → transaction FAILED (history kept); the same idempotencyKey can retry.
retry in 2^n min · cron every minute
processing error → attempts + 1 → FAILED after 5 tries
Notify your appoutbound · SQS → your webhookUrl
At-least-once delivery: dedupe on X-Event-Id (the SQS MessageId, stable across redeliveries).
Verify x-hub-signature = HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, sha256(project live API key)).

text.tspan: projects · provider_credentials · transactions · transaction_history · webhook_events · webhook_delivery_logs · admin_audits
retry inbound events (every minute) · prune old logs (daily, 03:00)
